subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and should that currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a public config surface and changes cost representation across status output, Control UI aggregation, docs, and USD-named API/storage fields.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so status, UI, docs, and stored fields stay consistent.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD per million tokens and direct non-USD provider balance display through the existing provider-usage unit path.

options.title: Add display-only symbols
options.body: Permit a narrow formatter override while explicitly keeping stored/API totals as USD-like estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so status, UI, docs, and stored fields stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The product choice spans the usage-cost feature, status/docs, and config semantics that history ties most strongly to this handle.
